name: Perdoo
description:
Connect Claude to your Perdoo workspace to understand and manage strategy, goals, OKRs, KPIs, teams, and progress updates in natural language.

Use Perdoo to find at-risk goals, summarize progress, explore strategic pillars and team ownership, review updates, and search across your organization. Authorized users can also draft objectives and key results, create KPIs, update goal details, and log check-ins. Access is governed by each user's existing Perdoo permissions, and the connector cannot delete or archive goals.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Perdoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Perdoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.perdoo.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Perdoo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perdoo lists 24 MCP tools, including create_kpi, create_objective, create_result, draft_okrs, get_company, get_kpi, get_me, get_objective, get_result, get_strategic_pillar, get_team, and list_kpis.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Perdoo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Perdoo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Perdoo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Perdoo is developed by Perdoo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
